In our #MeToo series, we explore the challenges female stringers face due to unconventional relationship with parent media organizations making it hard to hold assaulters to account. @makesyoucakes’s longread report @project_polis from #northeast of India.
https://t.co/5oq2CDGde6

Many female journalists reporting from India’s towns and villages realized their stories were not heard. Often working for more than one organization, they were not even sure who was going to address their complaints.
#WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo @project_polis https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

She recalled her case with much pain. She also said that this wasn’t the only one, but just the most verifiable one: through her formal complaint and emails to @NDTV. #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

‘I personally related to #TanushreeDutta’s story, someone who was rising in the industry but then suddenly disappeared’—a former journalist once seen as NDTV’s face in northeast. #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

Thrilled to be a stringer with @NDTV, it turned out to be the bane of her professional run. ‘I was the face of NDTV in northeastern India, but I didn’t even have an official ID.’ #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

Chakraborty would rub in the fact that he’d been on @NDTV payroll for 17 years: ‘I have worked with the likes of Barkha Dutt and Maya Mirchandani. Who are you?’ #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo @BDUTT @maya206 https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

‘As per IC rules, can’t investigate people not with @NDTV,’ said editorial director @soniandtv. In reality, NDTV could have initiated action in Pathak’s organization against him. #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

To @NDTV, she wrote the stringer kept banging on the door and when I opened he had nothing to discuss. He said, ‘I just came to hug you, you looked very beautiful today.’ Omission of alleged molestation is worth noting. #MeToo @makesyoucakes @project_polis
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

@NDTV’s disinterest in her complaint waned her motivation. After a serious accident on another reporting assignment for NDTV, she finally quit the channel in 2016. #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

‘When freelancers have a story commissioned, they can technically be seen as an employee for the benefit of POSH Act’—@Raksha_Kumar. #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

For freelancers, harassment is more likely by an external predator. This is where the role of the local complaints committee (LCC) becomes critical—@karunanundy. #UnorganizedSector #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

@NDTV prides itself for having some of most visible women in its top ranks. But this is hypocrisy, she said. ‘When it came to protecting a woman, they did nothing.’ #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo @Nidhi https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

Despite complaint against Chutia stating there was an ‘attempt to rape/molest’ her, no sections applied reflect it. ‘They didn’t collect my sweater, which was ripped, or his fingerprint marks on my hand and neck’ #MeToo @makesyoucakes @project_polis
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

Sabita Lahkar of NWMI said there’s clear political pressure. Chutia works for @Republic TV, which operates from same office space as BJP minister Himanta Sarma’s NewsLive channel. #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

The story did get a fair bit of coverage in select media but @Republic TV is yet to release a statement and has so far declined to give any comments. #ArnabGoswami #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

Under Indian constitution’s sixth schedule, effective in Mizoram, Meghalaya, parts of Tripura, Assam, sexual offences by locals are often resolved by tribal bodies. #NorthEast #WhatAfterMeToo? #MeToo #MeTooIndia @makesyoucakes @project_polis @IndiaMeToo
https://t.co/X5we0O8o9l

#THREAD. Major violations by @NDTV in sexual harassment case of its northeast reporter while on an assignment in Arunachal. @Republic TV hasn’t even bothered to issue statement in a sexual assault case by one of its reporters. @makesyoucakes reports for @project_polis. #MeToo

Protections against sexual harassment at workplace avlbl to journalists on official payrolls legally extend to stringers, too. Are #India’s news corporates willing to protect freelance women journalists? ⁦@makesyoucakes⁩ ⁦@project_polis⁩ #metoo https://t.co/qLtVYwC0nQ
